choice_prompt:7:1623211004.source_cn: 我们这里来了两个奇怪的家伙，大家都有点紧张呢！
choice_prompt:7:1623211004.male: We've got two suspicious-looking ones prowling the outskirts. Everyone's all feathers and tails!
choice_prompt:7:1623211004.female: We've got two suspicious-looking ones prowling the outskirts. Everyone's all feathers and tails!

say:8:1623211005:1.text: Magical creations... You mean, those brooms that whizz around a mage's house, and candles that burn forever?
say:8:1623211005:1.source_cn: 魔法造物……是那些会在魔法师屋子里飞来飞去的扫把和永远...
say:8:1623211005:1.male: Magical creations... You mean, those brooms that whizz around a mage's house, and candles that burn forever?
say:8:1623211005:1.female: Magical creations... You mean, those brooms that whizz around a mage's house, and candles that burn forever?

say:9:1623211006:0.text: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?
say:9:1623211006:0.source_cn: 他们真的有自己的想法吗？会不会突然失控，用魔法打我们呀？
say:9:1623211006:0.male: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?
say:9:1623211006:0.female: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?

say:13:1623211008:0.text: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!
say:13:1623211008:0.source_cn: 只要不是什么可疑的家伙就行，我和我的孩子们个不希望被打扰！
say:13:1623211008:0.male: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!
say:13:1623211008:0.female: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!

say:14:1623211009:1.text: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.
say:14:1623211009:1.source_cn: 是的……毕竟我们的孩子都还小。
say:14:1623211009:1.male: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.
say:14:1623211009:1.female: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.

say:16:1623211010:0.source_cn: 所以，他们靠近森林是要做什么呢？

choice_prompt:17:1623211010.source_cn: 所以，他们靠近森林是要做什么呢？

say:18:1623211011:1.text: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.
say:18:1623211011:1.source_cn: 但是……大家只是听说过魔法造物，第一次接触还挺紧张的。
say:18:1623211011:1.male: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.
say:18:1623211011:1.female: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.

say:19:1623211012:1.text: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.
say:19:1623211012:1.source_cn: 所以我们要不要试着给他们一些机会，也许他们真的没有恶意？
say:19:1623211012:1.male: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.
say:19:1623211012:1.female: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.

say:22:1623211014:0.text: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!
say:22:1623211014:0.source_cn: 试试看……但谁敢先靠近？你？他？不，可别让我去。
say:22:1623211014:0.male: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!
say:22:1623211014:0.female: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!

say:24:1623211015:1.text: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...
say:24:1623211015:1.source_cn: 嗯……要是他们忽然发疯怎么办？我、我还是有点怕。
say:24:1623211015:1.male: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...
say:24:1623211015:1.female: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...

say:25:1623211016:1.text: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
say:25:1623211016:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人……如果你也常来看看，我们就不会那么害怕了。
say:25:1623211016:1.male: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
say:25:1623211016:1.female: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.

choice_prompt:26:1623211016.text: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
choice_prompt:26:1623211016.source_cn: 魔法师大人……如果你也常来看看，我们就不会那么害怕了。
choice_prompt:26:1623211016.male: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
choice_prompt:26:1623211016.female: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.

say:28:1623211018:1.text: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.
say:28:1623211018:1.source_cn: 唔……既然魔法师大人这样答应了，我也没什么好说的。
say:28:1623211018:1.male: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.
say:28:1623211018:1.female: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.

say:29:1623211019:1.text: Alright. Who knows. This might actually make things interesting.
say:29:1623211019:1.source_cn: 好吧，也许森林会变得更有趣也说不定。
say:29:1623211019:1.male: Alright. Who knows. This might actually make things interesting.
say:29:1623211019:1.female: Alright. Who knows. This might actually make things interesting.

say:30:1623211020:1.text: So do swing by more often. Take a walk... and maybe keep an eye on those two new neighbors for the woods.
say:30:1623211020:1.source_cn: 以后也请您常来森林里走走，就当是……替我们大家悄悄看着...
say:30:1623211020:1.male: So do swing by more often. Take a walk... and maybe keep an eye on those two new neighbors for the woods.
say:30:1623211020:1.female: So do swing by more often. Take a walk... and maybe keep an eye on those two new neighbors for the woods.

choice:17:1:2.text: They want a life like yours.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 他们向往动物般的生活
choice:17:1:2.male: They want a life like yours.
choice:17:1:2.female: They want a life like yours.

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 他们不会伤害任何动物

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: （将他们的身份转述给动物们）

say:34:1623211003:1.text: A mage? Then you must know Lord Owlbear.
say:34:1623211003:1.source_cn: 魔法师……？那您一定认识枭熊大人吧？
say:34:1623211003:1.male: A mage? Then you must know Lord Owlbear.
say:34:1623211003:1.female: A mage? Then you must know Lord Owlbear.

choice:4:1:2.text: I'm a mage from the Lyceum.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我是莱希拉姆的魔法师
choice:4:1:2.male: I'm a mage from the Lyceum.
choice:4:1:2.female: I'm a mage from the Lyceum.

say:0:1623213001:0.text: Where is it? Don't tell me we're lost again!
say:0:1623213001:0.source_cn: 在哪呢？我们不会又走错路了吧！

say:1:1623213002:0.text: Stop nagging, or read the map yourself!
say:1:1623213002:0.source_cn: 别催我，要么你自己看地图！

say:1:1623214001:1.text: Are you here to arrest us?
say:1:1623214001:1.male: Are you here to arrest us?
say:1:1623214001:1.female: Are you here to arrest us?

choice_prompt:2:1623214001.text: Are you here to arrest us?
choice_prompt:2:1623214001.male: Are you here to arrest us?
choice_prompt:2:1623214001.female: Are you here to arrest us?

say:3:1623214002:0.text: Sorry! Something that looked like a bear burst out earlier, and he's still shaken up.
say:3:1623214002:0.source_cn: 对不起！我这位朋友有点神经质，我们刚才……好像被一头熊...
say:3:1623214002:0.male: Sorry! Something that looked like a bear burst out earlier, and he's still shaken up.
say:3:1623214002:0.female: Sorry! Something that looked like a bear burst out earlier, and he's still shaken up.

say:5:1623214003:0.text: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.
say:5:1623214003:0.source_cn: 熊？你心中立刻升起疑云——这片森林连熊的传闻都未曾有过。
say:5:1623214003:0.male: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.
say:5:1623214003:0.female: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.

choice_prompt:6:1623214003.text: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.
choice_prompt:6:1623214003.source_cn: 熊？你心中立刻升起疑云——这片森林连熊的传闻都未曾有过。
choice_prompt:6:1623214003.male: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.
choice_prompt:6:1623214003.female: A bear? A doubt surfaces immediately. This forest has never been home to bears, not even in hearsay.

say:8:1623214004:1.text: O-Oh, is that so? Then we must've imagined it. Fear plays tricks on the eyes, you know.
say:8:1623214004:1.source_cn: 是、是吗？那大概是我们看错了。人一害怕，眼睛就会出毛病。
say:8:1623214004:1.male: O-Oh, is that so? Then we must've imagined it. Fear plays tricks on the eyes, you know.
say:8:1623214004:1.female: O-Oh, is that so? Then we must've imagined it. Fear plays tricks on the eyes, you know.

say:9:1623214006:1.text: We're just passing through. Could you tell us where the Serene Lyceum is?
say:9:1623214006:1.source_cn: 我们只是路过的旅人，你能告诉我莱希拉姆在哪个方向吗？
say:9:1623214006:1.male: We're just passing through. Could you tell us where the Serene Lyceum is?
say:9:1623214006:1.female: We're just passing through. Could you tell us where the Serene Lyceum is?

say:10:1623214007:0.text: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.
say:10:1623214007:0.source_cn: 你不动声色地打量他们——衣裤沾着泥和陌生鸟羽，包裹鼓胀...
say:10:1623214007:0.male: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.
say:10:1623214007:0.female: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.

choice_prompt:11:1623214007.text: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.
choice_prompt:11:1623214007.source_cn: 你不动声色地打量他们——衣裤沾着泥和陌生鸟羽，包裹鼓胀，空气中还飘着一丝若有若无的火药味。他们绝非普通旅人。
choice_prompt:11:1623214007.male: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.
choice_prompt:11:1623214007.female: You study them without a word. Mud and unfamiliar bird feathers on their clothes, overstuffed packs, and a faint whiff of gunpowder. They're nothing like the ordinary travelers they claim to be.

say:12:1623214008:1.text: Oh, then this must be the forest people talk about.
say:12:1623214008:1.source_cn: 噢，那这附近应该就是传说中的森林了。
say:12:1623214008:1.male: Oh, then this must be the forest people talk about.
say:12:1623214008:1.female: Oh, then this must be the forest people talk about.

say:13:1623214009:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，你告诉我们一个很关键的信息。

say:15:1623214012:0.text: Um... When do we eat? Those mushrooms under the tree look pretty tasty. Can I...
say:15:1623214012:0.source_cn: 那个……我们什么时候吃饭？这树下的蘑菇看着挺不错的，能吃吗？
say:15:1623214012:0.male: Um... When do we eat? Those mushrooms under the tree look pretty tasty. Can I...
say:15:1623214012:0.female: Um... When do we eat? Those mushrooms under the tree look pretty tasty. Can I...

say:16:1623214013:1.text: Shut it, fool! Can't you see I'm talking?
say:16:1623214013:1.source_cn: 闭嘴，你这蠢货，没看到我在和人讲话吗？
say:16:1623214013:1.male: Shut it, fool! Can't you see I'm talking?
say:16:1623214013:1.female: Shut it, fool! Can't you see I'm talking?

say:17:1623214014:1.text: Sorry for the scene. We need to find something to eat. We won't bother you anymore. Farewell.
say:17:1623214014:1.source_cn: 让您见笑了。我们得先去弄点吃的，就不打扰了，再会。
say:17:1623214014:1.male: Sorry for the scene. We need to find something to eat. We won't bother you anymore. Farewell.
say:17:1623214014:1.female: Sorry for the scene. We need to find something to eat. We won't bother you anymore. Farewell.

say:19:1623214010:1.source_cn: 那我们还是自己找一找吧。

say:20:1623214011:1.text: Oh... *Cough* Maybe we took a wrong turn. Apologies. We'll check somewhere else.
say:20:1623214011:1.source_cn: 是吗？咳……可能是我们看错地图了。不打扰了，我们这就去...
say:20:1623214011:1.male: Oh... *Cough* Maybe we took a wrong turn. Apologies. We'll check somewhere else.
say:20:1623214011:1.female: Oh... *Cough* Maybe we took a wrong turn. Apologies. We'll check somewhere else.

choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 你们走错路了，离开这里

say:22:1623214005:1.text: Uh... Now that you ask, I'm not sure either. Maybe we just saw things.
say:22:1623214005:1.source_cn: 呃，你这么一问……我也有点不确定了，可能真是看错了。
say:22:1623214005:1.male: Uh... Now that you ask, I'm not sure either. Maybe we just saw things.
say:22:1623214005:1.female: Uh... Now that you ask, I'm not sure either. Maybe we just saw things.

choice:6:1:2.text: Are you sure it was a bear?
choice:6:1:2.male: Are you sure it was a bear?
choice:6:1:2.female: Are you sure it was a bear?

say:1:1623217001:1.text: I'd like to let you know about something that has genuinely pleased me.
say:1:1623217001:1.source_cn: 在开始之前，我想先说件让我挺欣慰的事。
say:1:1623217001:1.male: I'd like to let you know about something that has genuinely pleased me.
say:1:1623217001:1.female: I'd like to let you know about something that has genuinely pleased me.

say:2:1623217002:1.text: One of my students has been researching substitutes for magical materials, many of which are traditionally sourced from animals. Any progress could be a real kindness to the forest's ecosystem.
say:2:1623217002:1.source_cn: 我的一个学生最近在研究魔法材料的替代品。很多传统魔法材...
say:2:1623217002:1.male: One of my students has been researching substitutes for magical materials, many of which are traditionally sourced from animals. Any progress could be a real kindness to the forest's ecosystem.
say:2:1623217002:1.female: One of my students has been researching substitutes for magical materials, many of which are traditionally sourced from animals. Any progress could be a real kindness to the forest's ecosystem.

say:3:1623217003:1.text: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.
say:3:1623217003:1.source_cn: 我不反对传统，但这种和自然界和谐共处的新路子，我觉得更好。
say:3:1623217003:1.male: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.
say:3:1623217003:1.female: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.

choice_prompt:4:1623217003.text: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.
choice_prompt:4:1623217003.source_cn: 我不反对传统，但这种和自然界和谐共处的新路子，我觉得更好。
choice_prompt:4:1623217003.male: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.
choice_prompt:4:1623217003.female: I respect old ways. Still, I'd rather we learn to coexist with nature than keep taking from it.

say:5:1623217004:1.text: Indeed. I like young minds that think boldly and act on it.
say:5:1623217004:1.source_cn: 是啊。我喜欢有头脑，敢想又敢做的年轻人。
say:5:1623217004:1.male: Indeed. I like young minds that think boldly and act on it.
say:5:1623217004:1.female: Indeed. I like young minds that think boldly and act on it.

say:6:1623217006:1.text: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?
say:6:1623217006:1.source_cn: 话说回来，森林那边怎么样了？
say:6:1623217006:1.male: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?
say:6:1623217006:1.female: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?

choice_prompt:7:1623217006.text: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?
choice_prompt:7:1623217006.source_cn: 话说回来，森林那边怎么样了？
choice_prompt:7:1623217006.male: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?
choice_prompt:7:1623217006.female: Now then, how is everything going in the forest?

say:8:1623217007:1.text: Two talking magical creations? And they want to be a part of the forest? That's new. Just as intriguing as that paper, and potentially just as valuable.
say:8:1623217007:1.source_cn: 两个会说话的魔法造物？他们还想成为森林的一部分？这倒是...
say:8:1623217007:1.male: Two talking magical creations? And they want to be a part of the forest? That's new. Just as intriguing as that paper, and potentially just as valuable.
say:8:1623217007:1.female: Two talking magical creations? And they want to be a part of the forest? That's new. Just as intriguing as that paper, and potentially just as valuable.

say:9:1623217008:1.text: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.
say:9:1623217008:1.source_cn: 你应该多观察他们，或许会给我们带来更多惊喜。
say:9:1623217008:1.male: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.
say:9:1623217008:1.female: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.

choice_prompt:10:1623217008.text: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.
choice_prompt:10:1623217008.source_cn: 你应该多观察他们，或许会给我们带来更多惊喜。
choice_prompt:10:1623217008.male: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.
choice_prompt:10:1623217008.female: Keep observing them. This could turn out unexpectedly fascinating.

say:11:1623217009:1.text: Then I'll have to ask you to look after the forest folk for a while.
say:11:1623217009:1.source_cn: 这段时间，就麻烦你多照看一下森林的动物了。
say:11:1623217009:1.male: Then I'll have to ask you to look after the forest folk for a while.
say:11:1623217009:1.female: Then I'll have to ask you to look after the forest folk for a while.

say:13:1623217005:1.text: Mm. Even the best idea must survive reality.
say:13:1623217005:1.source_cn: 嗯，想法再好，也得经过实际验证才行。
say:13:1623217005:1.male: Mm. Even the best idea must survive reality.
say:13:1623217005:1.female: Mm. Even the best idea must survive reality.
